title: docs(pm-dispatch): the cloud lane takes p3 after p1/p2, dispatches its own security cards, and rings the lane of an objectstack blocker
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xFPfCk7EnqgfcNBr6YvDDxX)_

Fixes #31991

Lands after #32002 (same lane; it adds the `Request: assist` key this PR cites).

## 维护者速读

**需要你做的:** 无。本 PR 为 **Tier S**(`check-governed-merges.mjs --test` 实测),当前 head 还欠契约审查(contract review),通过后由 skills 席位在 #32002 合入后落地。
改了什么:把维护者 2026-11-09 的三条口头规则写进 cloud 车道章程 `lanes/cloud.md`。
规则二:取卡恢复 p3,p1/p2 仍先取。
规则一:cloud 安全卡按级入本车道队列,本车道照常派修、落地,不设常设停派;私卡写法与归属仍只指向 `security-findings.md` 第 6、9 节。
规则三:cloud 卡被 objectstack 卡阻塞时,挂 `pm:blocked` 或认领它的本车道席当即用 `Request: assist` 敲阻塞卡车道席,阻塞卡未认领或停车则敲 `triage#1`;每张阻塞卡一次,不限级。
行数不变(28/28):新增两行由删除同文件两行复述付清;`Request: assist` 的读取器已在 #32002 放宽到 p0–p3 与跨仓卡号,见文末。

## Maintainer rulings (verbatim, project chat, 2026-11-09)

1. 「cloud 车道的安全卡，cloud 车道自己负责派发，立卡修改skills」
2. 「继续处理 p3」 — supersedes 「cloud 后续只处理 p1 p2 的任务」; within a priority sweep p1/p2 are still taken first.
3. 「objectstack 阻塞卡，都应该邮箱通知对应的车道经理，优先处理。」

Provenance in the rule text is 「维护者令」, as the file already writes it; no issue numbers in rule text (`check:pm-skill-id-lint`).

## Changed lines (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/cloud.md`)

Rule 2, L25 rewritten in place (84 → 60 bytes). 「已在飞的卡照常续完」 goes with the floor it qualified: once p3 is taken there is no card above a floor left to finish.

```diff
-- 优先级地板:新派发只取 p1/p2;已在飞的卡照常续完(维护者令)。
+- 优先级:新派发先取 p1/p2,再取 p3(维护者令)。
```

Rule 1, L26 rewritten in place (99 → 118 bytes). It points to `security-findings.md` §6 (how the fix PR is written) and §9 (a private repo's cards belong to that repo's lane) and restates neither. 「留在本车道」 and 「私有仓的私有 `security` 卡」 are dropped because §3 L30 and §9 already say them: 「私有仓卡归该仓车道(cloud 即 cloud 车道),照其规则派修、复核、落地」.

```diff
-- 安全卡留在本车道:私有仓的私有 `security` 卡,机制只住 `security-findings.md`。
+- 安全卡照常按级入队派修落地,⛔ 无常设停派(维护者令);余照 `security-findings.md` §6、§9。
```

Rule 3, two new lines after it (118 and 117 bytes):

```diff
+- 卡阻于 objectstack 卡 ⇒ 挂 `pm:blocked` 或认领它的本车道席敲阻塞卡车道席 `Request: assist`。
+- 阻塞卡未认领或停车改敲 `triage#1`;每张阻塞卡一次,轮记列明敲了谁;不限级(维护者令)。
```

The ringer is the cloud seat that hangs `pm:blocked` on the card or claims it. It rings at once, usually at first touch. A blocked card is skipped at selection and usually has no claiming seat, so naming only the claiming seat would leave the ring to central triage's daily reconciliation. That central-triage backstop was in head `cabfd2ec` and is dropped (contract review 6755558952, should-fix), so `triage-duties.md` needs no mirror.

`project-forms.md` (as #32002 lands it) scopes `Request: assist` to p0/p1 waiting cards blocked on another lane's card that is unclaimed or idle 3 h, and rings that card's lane. The two lines above extend that row in three ways, all from ruling 3 and the card:

1. 「不限级(维护者令)」: every blocked cloud card rings, at any grade.
2. When the blocker is unclaimed or parked, the ring goes to `triage#1`, not to the blocker's lane.
3. A claimed blocker is rung even when it is not idle. There is no 3 h wait.

The answer stays `Notify: assist` per the key row; it is not restated here.

Neighbouring absolutes checked: L9 「分诊只做下文兜底」 still holds, because rule 3 no longer gives central triage any part, and L27 is still the backstop it refers to. L27 (4 h stateless backstop) and L23 (enterprise pick order) do not conflict.

## The cut and its home

The rule-3 text needs two lines (each line is capped at 120 bytes), so the file's net is +2 against its ceiling of 28. Both are paid by deleting whole lines that restate `cross-repo-coordination.md`. No re-wrap; no ceiling moves.

1. L8 「⛔ 不产 `domain:*`;机械三务(含首触定级)按 cross-repo-coordination.md 单车道仓条自理。」 Home: `cross-repo-coordination.md` L6 「单车道仓 `repo:*` 席自理机械三务,⛔ 不产 `domain:*`」 and L7 「机械三务 = 自扫 sweep、自打 `type`、自做首触」. This file's L3 already points there and L7 says the lane is a 单车道仓 seat.
2. L15 「只加应用侧:控制面、控制台、托管安装;平台缺陷立平台卡,本卡挂 `pm:blocked`+`Blocked-by:`。」 Home: `cross-repo-coordination.md` L23 「平台缺陷的修复是所属 `domain:*` 车道的平台卡;应用仓卡挂 `pm:blocked`+`Blocked-by:` 该卡」 and L24 「应用仓只加应用侧(cloud:控制面、控制台、托管安装)」.

This is a deviation from the order's "+1, one payment": the order expected one new line.

## Line reading

| File | Before | After | Ceiling |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `references/lanes/cloud.md` | 28 | 28 | 28 (headroom 0) |

Every changed or added line is ≤120 bytes (60, 118, 118, 117). `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` is not edited.

## Sweep

`security-findings.md` and `lanes/security.md` were read for any sentence that makes a private-repo security card wait on the maintainer or the security seat before development. **No hit.** Near misses, left as they are:

- `security-findings.md` L30 already says the private-repo card is dispatched, reviewed and landed by its own lane.
- L47 「修复要定契约的,交维护者」 (§6): an escalation for a fix that needs a contract decision, not a standing hold.
- L64 「中继拒 ⇒ … 席空缺交维护者」 (§9): only when the relay refuses.
- `lanes/security.md` L16, L48: private-repo cards do not pass through the security seat; L28 is about advisory fixes in public repos.

## Gates

On head `454f82b0`. Exit codes are in `/mnt/project-files/card-31991/gates-454f82b0.txt` (project file); the first head's are in `gates-cabfd2ec.txt`.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` lists the same 17 commands as on the first head. The order adds 3 more: `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, `check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` and `check-governed-merges.mjs --test`.
- All exit 0, including `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` and `check:doc-formula-expressions` (packages built since the first head).
- `check-governed-merges.mjs --test` exits 3. That is its GOVERNED verdict code, not a failure.

Tier: **Tier S** (`check-governed-merges.mjs --test .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/cloud.md`). The owning seat lands it after a `## Contract review` PASS on the current head. The card's "Tier H, human Approve" line does not apply.

Contract-review tier: `dispatch-gates --tier` reads no path-derived mandate for this path. The seat runs the contract review of record at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; per the maintainer's standing order of 2026-11-03, card threads do not run at that tier themselves.

Changeset: `skip-changeset`, because nothing publishes.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Open question (resolved by the seat)

`request:assist`'s field reader was folded into #32002 before it lands: it accepts priority p0–p3 and a blocker written as bare `#n` or `owner/name#n`, so a ring for a p2/p3 cloud card or one naming `objectstack-ai/cloud#a` reads. Landing order is recorded on #31989 (comment 6755471264): #32002 lands first, armed only once this PR holds a contract-review PASS on its head with green checks; this PR is armed as soon as #32002 merges.
